title: Alpha CRDs are still served — 0.37 will not read them
quote: `0.33.0`+ _only_ supports Karpenter v1beta1 APIs and will not work with existing Provisioner, AWSNodeTemplate or Machine alpha APIs. Do not upgrade to `0.37.0`+ without first upgrading to `0.32.x`. This version supports both the alpha and beta APIs, allowing you to migrate all of your existing APIs to beta APIs without experiencing downtime.
remediation: Upgrade to 0.32.x first and migrate every alpha object to the v1beta1 APIs before coming here.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.group | test("karpenter")) | "\(.metadata.name) served=\([.spec.versions[] | select(.served) | .name] | join(","))"'  # each Karpenter CRD and the API versions it still serves

title: Re-enabled webhooks need ports 8000, 8001, 8081 and 8443 reachable

detection.reason: whether a NetworkPolicy actually blocks these ports for the Karpenter pods depends on the policy's selectors and rules, which are not part of the collected projection

quote: Webhooks have been re-enabled by default starting in `0.37.3` to faciliate migration to `v1.0`. If your cluster has network policies that block Ingress then ports `8000`, `8001`, `8081`, `8443` will need to be allowlisted. You may still choose to disable webhooks through the helm chart.
remediation: Karpenter re-enables its webhooks from 0.37.3. Allowlist ports 8000, 8001, 8081 and 8443 for the Karpenter namespace in any NetworkPolicy that restricts ingress.
verifyCommand: kubectl get networkpolicy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) types=\((.spec.policyTypes // []) | join(","))"'  # check any policy in the Karpenter namespace against ports 8000, 8001, 8081 and 8443

title: Karpenter cannot provision until the EC2NodeClass CRD is updated

detection.reason: the CRD's status schema is not collected — only each CRD's name, group and served version names are

quote: Karpenter now adds a readiness status condition to the EC2NodeClass. Make sure to upgrade your Custom Resource Definitions before proceeding with the upgrade. Failure to do so will result in Karpenter being unable to provision new nodes.
remediation: Re-apply the Karpenter CRDs before upgrading. 0.37 waits on a readiness status condition that an un-updated EC2NodeClass CRD cannot store, and Karpenter is then unable to provision new nodes at all — the failure the vendor calls out explicitly.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.group | test("karpenter")) | "\(.metadata.name) served=\([.spec.versions[] | select(.served) | .name] | join(","))"'  # each Karpenter CRD and the API versions it still serves
